title: 订单数
question: 上个月订单数是多少？
sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
LIMIT 1000

    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
